f2.en: Rooted in New Zealand care, serving families across NZ and Australia
f2.zh: 根植新西兰的专业护理，服务新西兰与澳大利亚家庭

f3.en: Joyful was created to connect families with trustworthy hands and care knowledge that respects tradition. Our founder's care philosophy draws on Taiwan confinement-centre practice, nursing-informed service, and traditional Chinese medicine-informed postpartum recovery concepts. Our support does not stop at birth — we help families from the newborn stage through preschool childcare, and we also provide gentle elder companion support. Every caregiver in our network is trained, reviewed and supported by our team across New Zealand and Australia.
f3.zh: Joyful 馨悦月嫂服务中心希望为家庭连接值得信赖的双手，以及尊重传统的专业照护知识。我们的创办人护理理念结合台湾月子中心经验、护理服务思路与中医调理概念。我们的陪伴也不止于产后——从新生儿阶段一路延伸到入学前育儿支持，也提供温和的老人陪伴师服务。我们网络中的护理人员都经过培训与审核，并由团队在新西兰与澳大利亚持续支持。

f4.zh: 经过背景审核与专业培训的护理人员
